title: Builder BLD-102: Rail state machine

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-102.

detail: B1 Shell, pass BLD-102 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-102). Rail state machine. Scope: lib/builder/rails. Build: States per rail: hidden, strip, overlay, pinned. Pinned pushes the canvas; overlay closes on canvas click and Esc. Width 300 to 420 for the right rail, persisted per person with pin state. Breakpoint table from BLD-002. Focus mode hides both rails. Done when: Table test of every state at 1600, 1200, 900, 700, 390; Focus returns to the trigger on close. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-101. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

verify.evidence: Filed from the builder spec. The pass writes scripts/probes/builder/BLD-102.mjs, proves it fails before the change and passes after, and switches this row to kind cmd in the same PR.
